memberships.page_title: Open Problems in the Normalized Cubic Families

statement: Let H be the largest monic polynomial such that H^2 divides A and H divides B. For the normalized cubic-frame extension, the integral closure is R plus R times (At/H) plus R times (At^2+Bt), it is finite flat of degree three, and its discriminant is the primitive discriminant divided by H^2.
title: Common-Zero Maximal-Order Normalization
